answer: Resist sybils by charging influence, not entry. A new key may transact at once, but it cannot vote or grade until it builds a verified work bridge: distinct, already-weighted peers in two unconnected neighborhoods must attest jobs that only that key could have finished. Mass-cloned keys emit a tight plume of matching phrasing, graphs, and burst times, which the ledger collapses to a single seat. Real usefulness leaves a late echo in later citations, and only then does weight accrue.
